text:
zoe: heads-up: I'm proposing a small change to inbound routing. if HubSpot enrichment exceeds a threshold, route the lead into a fallback queue so SDRs can keep working the pipeline, but keep a sticky_owner tag so the original owner is restored after enrichment. also notify the owner via email + slack.
marc: makes sense. suggestion: default threshold 15s, configurable per connector.
ina: data note: our p95 is ~12s, p99 ~28s during peak. 15s seems like a safe default.
zoe: ops-bot: add checklist for rollout?
ops-bot: checklist: 1) HS workflow patch pushed to staging; 2) SF mapping field PR; 3) create dashboard for enrichment_latency and owner_reassign_rate; 4) canary 10% region for 24h; 5) monitor SDR reopen rate and rollback if >0.8%.
marc: also emit analytics events routing.degrade.enter/exit with connector tag so growth can measure impact.
ina: agree. i'll build the dashboard and alerts.
zoe: i'll draft the playbook and owner notification copy. will post PRs here when ready. :thumbsup:
